item.title: Resources to study Deep Learning
item.description:
Here are some free resources which will help you to study deep learning.

Pre requisite : Basic Linear Algebra, Basic Python

NOTE : MUST WATCH THESE VIDEOS IN SEQUENCE

  1. Neural Network / Perceptron

    • https://youtu.be/i1AqHG4k8mE?feature=shared
    • https://youtu.be/-KLnurhX-Pg?feature=shared
    • https://youtu.be/EJRFP3WmS6Q?feature=shared
    • https://youtu.be/KKSCmPUyczU?feature=shared

  2. PyTorch ( Lecture 1 to 17, remaining lectures do later.)

    • https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLqnslRFeH2UrcDBWF5mfPGpqQDSta6VK4&feature=shared

  3. DL theory : Andrew NG

    • https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLkDaE6sCZn6Gl29AoE31iwdVwSG-KnDzF&feature=shared

  4. DL practical : Fast.ai

    • Fundamental :

      • https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLfYUBJiXbdtSvpQjSnJJ_PmDQB_VyT5iU&feature=shared

    • Advance : (do it or not, up to you) https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLfYUBJiXbdtRUvTUYpLdfHHp9a58nWVXP&feature=shared

  5. More detailed stuff : Mitesh Khapra. BSc level lectures. https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLZ2ps__7DhBZVxMrSkTIcG6zZBDKUXCnM&feature=shared
